mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering immediate equity sell-offs as corporate earnings growth prospects weaken, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.5%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicate a strong economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals the onset of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months) during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering immediate equity market corrections and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals the Federal Reserve's imminent tightening of monetary policy, causing equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 (thousands of units) signals a housing market slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy faces headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1000) during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
